subject.title: fix(infra): import legacy plugin state partially (newest-first) instead of skipping when capacity is short

question: Should upgrades replace the shipped all-or-nothing plugin-state import with newest-first partial imports that retain the legacy source until the remainder fits?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally consistent, but the choice changes persisted-state upgrade and eviction semantics for existing installations and therefore needs explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve bounded partial imports
options.body: Accept the branch semantics because they keep startup non-blocking while making forward migration progress without treating old rows as fresh.

options.title: Keep all-or-nothing imports
options.body: Retain the shipped behavior and accept that capacity-constrained namespaces may defer the full legacy source until enough space becomes available.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded partial imports
recommendation.body: Accept the branch semantics because they keep startup non-blocking while making forward migration progress without treating old rows as fresh.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion identifies @obviyus as requesting the migration behavior and the PR is assigned to them.
